description: This file defines the InvalidForwardedHeaderNameException class, which is an exception type used within the Laminas Diactoros package. It provides a static method for generating an exception when an invalid X-Forwarded-* header name is encountered.

classes.name: InvalidForwardedHeaderNameException
classes.description: An exception class indicating an invalid X-Forwarded header name.

methods.name: forHeader
methods.description: Static factory method that creates an exception with a message indicating the provided header name is invalid.
